subject: Thou Hast Raised the Earth
text: The Eye of Malroth must be used while standing directly in front of the mountain that becomes the road opening; using it anywhere else does not trigger the achievement.

evidence.quote: You must be directly in front of the mountain that turns into the opening for the road for this to pop. Using the Eye anywhere else to open it won't trigger it.

subject: Thou Hast Passed Through Hell
text: A commenter asked whether a glitch bypasses the Rhone passage, noting that more players beat the game than traverse the cave. This is an unconfirmed question.

evidence.quote: Is there a glitch that bypasses the Rhone passage? I'm noticing a lot more people beating the game than those traversing the cave.
